digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: A fresh tracker clone carries events but not git-ignored local state, causing .env-id to be regenerated and invalidating all attestations signed under the prior environment identity.

Minting a new .env-id into a store already holding events from a different environment must emit a loud stderr warning naming the prior environment identity and the affected git-ignored files, with completion gated by REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1 environment variable.

rebar fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH issue when the current environment's author(s) also wrote events under a different environment identity, surfacing re-identification store-wide rather than at a per-ticket gate.

Multi-clone and multi-author workflows legitimately carry distinct environment identities in the same store; the ENV_ID_MISMATCH check must not fire on healthy topologies with different authors per environment.

The re-clone carry-over list (.env-id, .opcert-key, .opcert-key.pub, .ensure-applied) and recovery steps must be documented in docs/concurrency.md with explicit warnings about attestation consequences.
